instruction: Please play this streaming video for me: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_4x3/bipbop_4x3_variant.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (bipbop 4x3 variant). Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric to verify VLC is playing the specified URL. Same complexity as original - simple streaming task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both that VLC is in 'playing' state AND that the correct URL is being played
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) properly extracts VLC status via HTTP interface and saves status.xml
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly handles HLS streaming URLs - important since the test URL is an HLS manifest (.m3u8)
Metric uses correct parameter name 'rule' instead of 'expected', properly receiving the rules dictionary from get_rule()
Multiple fallback methods for URL extraction from VLC's XML increase robustness (checks filename, URI, location, title fields)
Special handling for HLS streams where VLC may show just the filename instead of full URL (lines 107-114 in vlc.py)
Edge cases handled: returns 0 if VLC not playing, or if URL info not found in XML
Comprehensive logging provides good debugging information
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding postconfig to explicitly verify VLC HTTP interface is accessible before evaluation, though current setup should work since VLC is launched with HTTP interface enabled

Minor: If getter fails to fetch status.xml (HTTP error), it returns None which would cause metric to fail - this is acceptable behavior but could be more gracefully handled with explicit error messages
